notes.title: Controller support is here! December 20, 2022
notes.content:
A controller can now be used in the main game-play.

Controls:
- Look around using the [b]Left Analog Stick.[/b]
- Open laptops and exit the office using the [b]Bottom Face Button (A, x).[/b]
- Use computers and close doors using the [b]Right Trigger (RT, R2).[/b]
- Shine the flashlight using the [b]Left Trigger (LT, L2).[/b]
- Navigate through rooms and computers with the controller's [b]D-pad.[/b]

You can find the map navigation controls [url=http://gamesmmm.com/games/fpah-map-controls.png]here![/url]
[img]http://gamesmmm.com/games/fpah-map-controls.png[/img]

notes.title: First update. November 8, 2022
notes.content:
The difficulty of shifts 1 and 2 have been increased. There is now a consequence for ignoring the checkpoints for too long.

Bug fixes:
- The shift you are on in the main story will no longer change after completing a custom shift.
